title: The release read by key (audit #53 part 2)
assertion: A release's shared types held once per release and manifest (two releases at most); each run's keyed records read by its own codes and ZIP; every stored row equal to what the old read and adapter (frozen at 3c1b289) give for the same run; a lookup outside the keys fetched, a row outside the key set or codes priced unequal to it fail the run as RELEASE_READ_OUTSIDE_FETCH before its batch is recorded, never a row priced ENGINE_ERROR
noFileReason: The release read is tested on a release built in memory from SYNTHETIC release 900001; no file.
